evidence.why: Complete input dispatch and cache-only persistence loop.
Visual update precedes copying shared confirmation into the cached byte.
Save request is deferred through a pending flag.

facts.rationale: Preserves input priority and exceptional branches while correcting the implication that confirmation immediately persists the newly toggled value.
facts.value: Back (0x20) has highest priority and bypasses the startup gate: it commits cached stage settings, requests deferred saving, sets cooldown 5, initializes Additional Rules, and removes the controller GObj. Other controls require mnStageSw_804D6BF4 == 0. Confirmation (0x200) changes shared confirmed_selection, rejecting an attempt to disable an enabled entry when the cached enabled count is at most one. For a valid highlighted index, both accepted and rejected confirmation paths then write all available stages' existing cached bytes through gm_801641E4 and return. This loop does not incorporate the newly changed shared byte itself: fn_80236998 later copies confirmed_selection into the cache after updating its display. Start (0x100) commits the cache and requests saving, then routes GM_MENU to GM_VS and other modes through mn_8022F4CC. Directional input is handled last; confirmation with an invalid highlighted index falls through to directional checking rather than Start.

evidence.why: Column scan and asymmetric candidate bounds.

facts.rationale: Retains the algorithm and tie rule while qualifying the previously unrestricted termination claim with the actual caller domain and missing upper-bound check.
facts.value: Inputs below 15 select column 0–14; other inputs select column 15–28. A preliminary availability scan returns -1 if the selected column is empty. Otherwise an in-range available requested entry is returned directly, followed by an outward search checking the lower candidate before the upper candidate at each distance. For intended requests 0–29, this gives nearest-entry selection with lower-index tie priority and termination guaranteed by the preliminary scan. Request 29 occurs when moving right from left-column index 14 and searches downward from index 28. This is not a general safe search for every u8 input: the lower-candidate branch checks only the column's lower bound, so requests above 29 can index beyond the 29-element mapping before reaching the valid column.
